params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Ashe's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} equal to {{critical damage|0 to 100|0 to 100|critScaling=true}} of the {{as|attack's damage}}. {{tip|critical strike|Critical strikes}} do not deal any additional damage.
params.description2: {{sbc|Innate - Frost Shot:}} '''Ashe's''' basic attacks and ability hits apply ''Frost'' to enemies for 2 seconds, which {{tip|slow|slows}} them by {{pplevel|key=%|20 to 30}} for the duration.
params.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Critical Slow:}} '''Ashe's''' {{tip|critical strike|critical strikes}} double ''Frost's'' slow strength to {{pplevel|key=%|20*2 to 30*2}}, decaying over the first second of the duration to its normal strength.
params.notes:
* '''Ashe's''' critical strikes are still considered {{as|critical strike damage}} and thus will be reduced by {{iis|Randuin's Omen}} {{nie|Resilience}}.
* {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} will also be empowered to deal bonus damage at the cost of not dealing additional damage on {{tip|critical strike|critical strikes}}.
* {{ri|Cheap Shot}} will trigger on a subsequent basic attack even when the target is no longer slowed.{{bug|2}}
<!--Blurb-->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Ashe}} {{tip|basic attacks}} deal increased damage based on her critical strike chance and critical strike damage.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Innate - Frost Shot:}} {{cis|Ashe}} basic attacks apply a {{tip|slow}} on-hit.
params.blurb3: {{sbc|Innate - Critical Slow:}} {{cis|Ashe}} {{tip|Critical Strike|critical strikes}} deal no bonus damage but apply an empowered {{tip|slow}}.

description.plain: Innate: Ashe's basic attacks deal bonus physical damage equal to 0% – 100% (+ Infinity Edge 0% – 40%) (based on critical strike chance) of the attack's damage. Critical strikes do not deal any additional damage.

description2.plain: Innate - Frost Shot: Ashe's basic attacks and ability hits apply Frost to enemies for 2 seconds, which slows them by 20% – 30% (based on level) for the duration.

description3.plain: Innate - Critical Slow: Ashe's critical strikes double Frost's slow strength to 40% – 60% (based on level), decaying over the first second of the duration to its normal strength.

blurb.plain: Innate: Ashe basic attacks deal increased damage based on her critical strike chance and critical strike damage.

blurb2.plain: Innate - Frost Shot: Ashe basic attacks apply a slow on-hit.

blurb3.plain: Innate - Critical Slow: Ashe critical strikes deal no bonus damage but apply an empowered slow.

params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} While ''Ranger's Focus'' is inactive, '''Ashe's''' basic attacks {{tip|on-attack}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Focus'' for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and stacking up to 4 times. Stacks expire one by one every second when the duration ends.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} For 6 seconds, '''Ashe''' gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and empowers her basic attacks to fire a flurry of five arrows that deal {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}}. The flurries {{tip|applies life steal|apply}} {{as|{{sti|life steal}}}} and ''{{ai|Frost Shot|Ashe}}'' per arrow, but apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects only once.
params.leveling2:
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|20 to 60}}%}}
{{st|Physical Damage Per Arrow|{{as|{{ap|110/5 to 130/5}}% AD}}|Total Damage Per Flurry|{{as|{{ap|110 to 130}}% AD}}}}
params.description4: ''Ranger's Focus {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Ashe's''' basic attack timer.''
params.notes:
* The flurries deal 1 instance of {{tip|basic damage}} followed by 4 instances of a non-reactive type of damage (either {{tip|default damage|default}} or {{tip|proc damage|proc}}).<!--One test to determine the difference is Teemo's W, but the test is hard to set-up since the first bolt removes Teemo's W.-->
** The flurries are classified as a basic attack on a script level, but are considered an ability for other effects (e.g. {{cai|Sap Magic|Maokai}}).{{Bug}}
* The first flurry of a ''Ranger's Focus'' cast fires{{ft|one additional arrow, dealing 20% increased total damage.|six arrows, dealing a total of {{as|{{ap|110*1.2 to 130*1.2}}%|attack damage}} {{as|attack damage}}.}}
* ''Ranger's Focus'' works against {{tip|structures}}.
* Flat damage reductions (e.g. {{cai|Tantrum|Amumu}}, {{cai|Nimble Fighter|Fizz}}, or {{cai|Eclipse|Leona}}) apply per arrow, resulting in extremely increased effectiveness against ''Ranger's Focus''.
** The sole exception is {{iis|Warden's Mail}} {{nie|Rock Solid}}, as that applies per {{tip|cast instance}} rather than per damage instance.
* A flurry can apply 5 stacks of {{iis|Black Cleaver}} {{nie|Carve}} to a single target as it deals 5 instances of {{as|physical damage}}.
* ''Ranger's Focus'' also empowers {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nie|Wind's Fury}} bolts to become a flurry of 5 bolts each as well.
** The empowered bolts use '''Ashe's''' attack projectile, including her missile speed (2500 compared to their default 2000).
** The bolts are evenly distributed among the targets, but a single target cannot be hit by more than 5 bolts.
** These flurries also apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects only once to each target hit.
* Because ''Focus'' stacks are generated {{tip|on-attack}}, {{iis|Runaan's Hurricane}} {{nies|Wind's Fury}} bolts will not generate any.
params.tips:
* While ''Ranger's Focus'' has no cooldown, the ability has a minimum downtime that is the time it takes for '''Ashe''' to generate 4 stacks of ''Focus''.
** This downtime is {{fd|{{#expr:4*1/{{ccd|Ashe|as_base}} round 2}}}} seconds at '''Ashe's''' base attack speed ({{as|{{fd|{{ccd|Ashe|as_base}}}}|attack speed}}), 20 seconds at minimum attack speed ({{as|{{fd|0.2}}|attack speed}}), and {{fd|1.{{Recurring|33}}}} seconds at maximum attack speed ({{as|{{fd|3.003}}|attack speed}}).
** This can be further decreased with effects that allow exceeding the attack speed cap or reset the attack timer.
<!--Blurb-->

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ashe''' shoots a volley of arrows in a cone in the target direction, each dealing {{as|physical damage}} to the first enemy hit, and applying ''{{ai|Frost Shot 2|Ashe|Critical Slow}}'' to enemy {{tip|champions}} hit.
params.description2: Enemies can intercept multiple arrows but do not take damage from any beyond the first.
params.effect radius: {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|1200|Not including the offset, see notes}}
params.notes:
* The missiles are spawned in a straight horizontal line 75 units in front of '''Ashe''', with a total width of 75/100/100/123/123 units.
** Between each missile spawn location is a distance of {{fd|12.5}} units, except for the two outermost ones at the last two ranks (which are {{fd|11.5}} units from the closest other one), and the two centermost missiles at ranks 2 and 4 (which have 20 units between them and 15 units to the next missile, respectively).
** This inconsistent behaviour of spawn locations means the angle between each missile can vary off of {{fd|4.625}}{{degrees}} slighty.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
<!--Blurb-->

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ashe''' sends a hawk spirit to a location, granting {{tip|sight}} of the area along its path{{ft|repeatedly for {{fd|0.5}} seconds after every 100 units traveled|for effectively up-to {{fd|1.8}} seconds at any location}}and at its destination for 5 seconds.
params.description2: '''Ashe''' periodically [[ammunition|stocks]] a ''Hawkshot'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
params.notes:
* ''Hawkshot's'' recharge timer seems to start at the beginning of the game, even prior to ranking the ability, but upon actually ranking the ability, it starts with one charge and the recharge timer starts from 0.
* ''Hawkshot'' will ping enemy champions it spots if allies didn't already have vision of them, and put a 'revealed' visual effect on them for {{tt|{{fd|2.75 seconds}}|Estimated}}, but does not actually reveal the units in particular, and is removed if the champion leaves the area.
* Allies can still see ''Hawkshot'' ping even if they're affect by nearsighted, which allows allies to know the position of unspecified enemies during Nocturne's Paranoia.
* '''Ashe''' marks enemy champions who were previously unseen but were revealed ''Hawkshot'' in order to gain [[assist]] credit, lasting for the standard credit timer.
* ''Hawkshot'' will trigger upon colliding with {{ai|Blade Whirl|Samira}} or {{ai|Wind Wall|Yasuo}} but not {{ai|Unbreakable|Braum}}.
* ''Hawkshot'' will grant 0.33 points of [[vision score]] for each champion revealed.
<!--Blurb-->
